content:
**Coach:** *"Ram, I hear you—parties happen, and it’s all part of the journey! What matters is that you’re already thinking ahead. Tomorrow is a fresh start: fuel your body with the good stuff, hydrate well, and show up stronger for yourself. One meal doesn’t define you—your commitment to bounce back does. You’ve got this. Let’s make tomorrow count!"*

*(Kept it supportive, action-oriented, and tied to the "tomorrow focus" he mentioned. Encourages accountability without guilt.)*
